## Denise — the missing goose of Marapore

Denise is a *gigantic white goose* belonging to an unnamed stallion in the G4 novel *Daring Do and the Marked Thief of Marapore*. Her owner fears she has vanished; Daring Do later finds her among Mojo's enchanted captives. She is an animal companion, not a pony. See the [published book record](https://books.google.com/books?id=RI2ADwAAQBAJ) and [G4 avian character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_non-pony_characters/Avians).

*Name and continuity:* Denise is named by her owner and Daring in the story itself—not by a fan naming convention. The book was written by G. M. Berrow under Daring Do's fictional author identity, A. K. Yearling. This is an officially licensed G4 *prose* appearance, not a verified television appearance. No alternate identity, intelligible dialogue, or credited voice actor is known.

*Appearance:* The story describes her as an unusually large white goose. I found no verified portrait or show still of Denise.

## Important moments

1. *The missing goose* — “The Wisdom of Colts and Scholars,” book chapter 8. A red-cloaked stallion reports his missing goose, then mistakes another villager's honking nose-blow for Denise.
2. *Freed from Mojo's spell* — “The Hollowed Hideout,” book chapter 11 (p. 139). Daring calls Denise and Bruno by name; the huge white goose steps forward, her enchantment lifts, and she joins the freed pets as Daring devises a rescue. See the [book chapter guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Daring_Do_and_the_Marked_Thief_of_Marapore).

These are novel scenes, not numbered TV episodes; video timestamps do not apply.
